caseNameFull: Marsh, Secretary of State of Nebraska v. Dworak
attorneys: Clarence A. H. Meyer, Attorney General of Nebraska, and Richard H. Williams and Robert A. Nelson, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellants., August Ross and Robert E. O’Connor for appellees.

opinions.text:
Appeal from D. C. Neb. Motion of appellants to defer consideration of the motion to dismiss and to defer filing brief in opposition granted.

Mr. Justice Fortas took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
